description: Max pain of an option expiry: the settlement price at which holders of all calls and puts together would be paid the least, from the open interest per strike (1 contract = 1 unit of the underlying). Two modes. LIVE (omit strikes): reads one expiry's open interest from Deribit (BTC, ETH; coin-settled, payouts shown in USD), Binance (BTC, ETH, XAU, XAG; USDT) or Bybit (BTC, ETH; USDT); one venue per result, venues are never merged; omit expiry to get the nearest expiry that has open interest. An expiry with no open interest yet, or where the venue leaves a contract's open interest unstated, comes back with available false and the reason, never a number. YOUR OWN DATA (pass strikes): max pain from the open interest you supply, nothing is fetched; optional spotPrice adds how far max pain sits from it. Returns maxPainStrike (the lowest if several tie; tiedStrikes lists all), the minimum and maximum total payout, total call and put open interest, the put/call open-interest ratio, and the payout at every strike (callPayoutUsd, putPayoutUsd, totalPayoutUsd). Max pain is a descriptive statistic of open positions, not a forecast of the settlement price; who holds which side, early exercise and the venue's settlement-price method are not modelled. Edge cases: your own data takes strikes (strike above zero, open interest 0 or more, finite) and an optional spotPrice, never together with exchange, underlying or expiry; ties go to the lowest strike and all tied strikes are listed. Not covered: who holds which side, hedging, early exercise and the venue settlement-price method. Use when the user asks for the max pain strike of BTC or ETH options for an expiry, or for max pain from open interest they have.

exchange.description: Live mode: venue to read. Default deribit. Not with strikes.

expiry.description: Live mode: expiry as YYMMDD, e.g. 261225. Omit for the nearest expiry that has open interest. Not with strikes.

spotPrice.description: Your own data: optional price today, adds the distance from max pain to it

strikes.description: Your own data: one row per strike, { strike: number > 0, callOpenInterest: number >= 0, putOpenInterest: number >= 0 }. A strike is listed once; at least one open interest must be above 0.

callOpenInterest.description: Open interest in calls at this strike, in contracts of one unit of the underlying, 0 or more

putOpenInterest.description: Open interest in puts at this strike, in contracts of one unit of the underlying, 0 or more

underlying.description: Live mode: Deribit BTC or ETH; Binance BTC, ETH, XAU or XAG; Bybit BTC or ETH. Default BTC. Not with strikes.
